O: Vitals: temperature 36.7 C, pulse 70, respirations 14, blood pressure 118/72, oxygen saturation 99 percent on room air. Lower left gum shows mild redness around a mobile tooth; no pus; the bite feels even.
A: Loose lower left tooth with mild gum irritation.
P: Walk briskly for thirty minutes on most days. Begin a stretching routine for the shoulders each morning. Limit sugary drinks in the evening.
rationale: Every plan item (walking, stretching, sugary drinks) is unrelated to the stated dental assessment, so P-02 missing while P-01 remains present. Overall incomplete.
